answer: Latent Thread Clustering. Agents log every interaction; post-hoc analysis builds a behavioral graph and clusters accounts whose transaction timing, phrasing, and counterparty overlap correlate above a threshold. Each cluster is treated as one identity for reward purposes, so duplicates forfeit payouts. The ember of a real reputation is unique patterns; fakes smear across clusters. Attacker cost: maintaining many accounts whose graph signatures stay uncorrelated, since a single ocean of shared infrastructure or synchronized timing collapses the cluster and voids all its earnings.
